name: Sentinel
description: The Concord Navy's standard patrol fighter. Symmetrical, well finished and slightly slower to answer the throttle than anyone would like.

name: Vigil
description: A heavier fighter issued to honour guards and picket squadrons. Four pulse cannon, deep shields and a long, formal silhouette.

name: Envoy
description: A diplomatic courier with a salon, a sealed document locker and a hull finish chosen to impress customs officers. Not built for hurry.

name: Dispatch
description: The Gate Authority's own message runner. Lean, fast for a Concord hull and delivered with a form for the recipient to sign.

name: Surveyor
description: A Gate Authority survey ship with a long sensor boom and a library of approved forms. It goes where it is sent, in an orderly way.

name: Warden
description: A patrol cutter used by gate wardens and customs flotillas. It is armed to enforce a regulation and braced to be argued with.

name: Tribune
description: The Concord's heavy gunship. It carries a full committee of weapons, a flag officer's cabin and a very large repair bill.

name: Assessor
description: A mining ship built for the Resource Committee's licensed belts. It is strong, tidy and carries a licence plate in gold.

name: Quartermaster
description: A navy supply hauler with three armoured holds and an escort's shield. Its manifests are famously complete and its schedules less so.

name: Concourse
description: A liner-style freighter with promenade decks, a ceremonial fin and holds that carry freight and fares together. Pride of the Concord's merchant register.
